# Leoforce

> Leoforce is a recruitment and talent acquisition platform offering AI-powered job matching and candidate sourcing solutions.

Leoforce operates globally with presence in the USA, Canada, India, and Costa Rica, providing remote job opportunities and recruitment services. The platform leverages advanced matching technology to connect job seekers with opportunities across multiple regions.

## Key Topics

- job search
- recruitment
- talent acquisition
- remote jobs
- job listings
- candidate matching
- location filtering
- global hiring
- career opportunities
- AI-powered recruitment

## Careers & Opportunities

- [Leoforce Jobs](https://leoforce.com/careers): Leoforce careers page with remote job opportunities globally
- [Leoforce Job Listings](https://leoforce.com/Careers/JobList.html): Leoforce job listings across USA, Canada, India, Costa Rica
